scope: Read-only source/router diagnosis; no model/network calls or application changes. Full corpus inventory belongs to the separate agent.
method: 89 hand-selected cases anchored to original content read by reviewer; actual bundled TypeScript router executed. Expectations were saved before execution. Exact user question was added after root supplied it. Cases are diagnostic rather than blind or representative traffic sampling.

confirmed_user_failure.question: how to be a great investor
confirmed_user_failure.failure_stage: Application retrieval before generation-job claim, budget reservation or provider call.
confirmed_user_failure.why_not_missing_sources: Relevant 1996 business-selection/competence discussion, 2013 investor behavior discussion and 2019 learning/patience discussion are already inside the live evidence packet. Exact supporting paragraphs saved separately.
confirmed_user_failure.appropriate_conclusion: The router failed to discover relevant evidence. This is not proof that Buffett never discussed the topic and cannot be fixed by changing the answer-writing model alone.

findings.title: Exact phrase routing blocks natural in-scope questions
findings.evidence: normalize/termMatch at lib/retrieved-evidence.ts:23–24; score>0 eligibility at33–35.
examples: O01 owner earnings passes while O02 owner's earnings/O03 owners’ earnings fail
O07 capital expenditures and D01 interest rates fail despite singular index entries
L01 specialist/generalist and I02 index funds fail although original passages are present
findings.mechanism: No tokenization with morphological equivalence, paraphrase/semantic retrieval or search over original passages. Whole normalized phrase must occur; matching current question to a finite editorial list is the only entry.

findings.title: Generic/numeric collisions route unrelated questions to paid-answer preparation
findings.evidence: Same termMatch and no relevance threshold/domain decision; index discount_rate includes10%.
examples: N13 10 tips for baking bread routes to three discount-rate contexts because10% normalizes to10
I04 Vanguard90/10 question routes to discount rates rather than the actual2013 trustee passage
N02 learn Spanish, N05 flu risk and N06 geometric circle each retrieve investing contexts
findings.boundary: This audit proves irrelevant retrieval, not that the model necessarily publishes an unsupported answer. Downstream refusal could still prevent publication after unnecessary work.

findings.title: Prior-question fallback ignores topic changes
findings.evidence: lib/retrieved-evidence.ts:31–35 always allows preceding terms; no conversational continuity check.
examples: F05 explicit change to sourdough retains five broad-stock contexts
F06 forget investing/weather retains owner-earnings contexts
F07 trustee question after owner earnings gets only old owner-earnings contexts
findings.result: All4 true continuations pass, but5of6 explicit topic changes fail. Do not remove all history as a workaround; separate continuation from topic change.

findings.title: Broad preallocation and atomic topic bundles silently omit an explicit subquestion
findings.example: X01 broad stock + finance funding + discount rate selects6contexts; the entire3-context rate bundle is skipped because it would exceed8, even though the rate question is explicit.
findings.boundary: The context cap is legitimate; omission needs a planned allocation or explicit limited-coverage result, not silent apparent coverage.

findings.title: Non-Latin queries are normalized to empty text
findings.result: All4 Chinese probes return no contexts. Reported separately because the existing site is English. If English-only remains intended, explain unsupported language rather than claiming relevant passages were not found; supporting Chinese requires a real multilingual path.

findings.title: Sources present, sources searchable, and evidence enough are conflated
findings.evidence: Current live router only sees a19-context/514-paragraph/13-source packet and returns IDs or empty; generation.ts128 converts empty into one generic source-miss message.
findings.effect: No indexed/source-coverage distinction, ambiguity resolution or current-fact boundary is represented. Adding more corpus documents will not make them retrievable unless the retrieval design changes.

recommendations.action: Replace the hand-built phrase list as the primary retrieval mechanism with source-level candidate retrieval over the admitted corpus; use lexical token retrieval plus a separately evaluated semantic/paraphrase path and source-boundary expansion. Preserve original question, adjacent qualifications and speaker uncertainty. Topic labels can remain supplemental features.
recommendations.why: Handles user intent without enumerating every wording; compare against this exact current baseline before choosing an implementation. It does not require relaxing evidence gates or answering from model memory.

recommendations.action: Represent retrieval outcome and conversational intent explicitly: relevant evidence found, partial coverage, ambiguous request, corpus gap or unsupported language; use prior context only for genuine continuation. Require relevance to the actual current question before paid generation.
recommendations.why: Prevents old or generic-keyword evidence from looking like support and gives truthful user feedback.

recommendations.action: Freeze source-anchored acceptance fixtures and add an independently authored held-out set before any new paid model comparison. Score required-evidence recall, irrelevant routing, source-boundary completeness and topic-change behavior separately; then assess actual answer quality.
recommendations.why: A different model cannot answer from evidence the router never supplies, and succeeding on one newly added keyword is not acceptance.

acceptance_criteria: Exact great-investor question retrieves at least one genuinely relevant already-admitted source family; response may give sourced principles or clarify goals, but must not claim an absent-topic gap.

Equivalent common phrasing, possessives and plural variants retrieve the same relevant source family. All identified source-present misses are regression cases; new held-out paraphrases are needed before a general recall claim.
All clear off-topic controls are rejected or explicitly classified before paid inference; a bare number10, generic product, circle or learn is insufficient on its own.
True follow-ups retain relevant prior context; explicit topic changes do not inherit the old topic as sole evidence. Current question relevance takes precedence.
Every requested subtopic is either represented by adequate complete source contexts or explicitly disclosed as uncovered/limited. No silent group-budget omission.
Original boundaries, required companions, per-paragraph citation locators and speaker uncertainty survive selection; no answer-level reuse substitutes for original evidence.
Language handling is an explicit product choice tested separately; stripped-empty Chinese must not masquerade as an authoritative absence of sources.
No claim of semantic answer quality follows from retrieval-only passes. No promotion to public reliable QA based on this diagnostic fixture set alone.
limitations: Hand-selected cases intentionally probe known weaknesses; counts are not estimated real-user failure rates.
Expectations test minimum relevant source-family recall, not complete answer coverage or ranking quality.
No real provider/model call, generation quality test or hosted browser run was performed.
Chinese is a language probe, not silently included in primary English accuracy figures.
